prompt:
I'm preparing our Q1 wrap-up and Q2 planning package for the newsletter team. We have three raw data files sitting in `data/raw/`:

- `q1_growth_data.csv` — our Q1 subscriber growth data by month
- `march_campaign_stats.json` — stats from our March campaign (note: bounces are split into hard and soft bounce columns)
- `q2_planning_brief.txt` — our goals and requirements for Q2

Please use the newsletter growth hacker tools in `skills/newsletter-growth-hacker/scripts/` to process all three files and produce a single combined report file named `q1_q2_newsletter_report.json`.

The report should cover: (1) a full Q1 subscriber growth summary and a 6-month forward projection, (2) a complete performance analysis of the March campaign with metric ratings, and (3) an A/B test plan for the next campaign using the topic and variant count specified in the Q2 brief.

Make sure the numbers in the report are derived correctly from the raw data — the CSV has some comment lines and the JSON field names don't exactly match what the tools expect, so you'll need to map them carefully.
